summary: Tested Socket.IO real-time broadcasting fix for email-to-ticket sync. FIXED: Socket.IO was not connecting due to (1) logging error with request_id format affecting Socket.IO internal loggers, (2) incorrect Socket.IO path configuration for Kubernetes ingress routing. Both issues resolved. All 14 backend tests passed, frontend Socket.IO connection verified working, real-time ticket:created events confirmed broadcasting correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: RequestIdFilter now added to ALL handlers on root logger, not just the local logger - was causing Socket.IO logging to fail
FIXED: Socket.IO ASGI app now configured with socketio_path='/' and mounted at /api/socket.io to match ingress routing
FIXED: Frontend RealtimeContext.js updated to use /api/socket.io/ path instead of /socket.io/
VERIFIED: serialize_doc() is called before sio.emit() in both broadcast_ticket_created and broadcast_ticket_update
VERIFIED: broadcast_ticket_update uses correct 4-argument signature (ticket_id, action, data, updated_by)
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test user/session for testing, cleaned up after
context_for_next_testing_agent: Socket.IO real-time is fully working. Frontend connects via /api/socket.io/ path. Backend broadcasts ticket:created and ticket:update events with properly serialized data (no ObjectId). Logging error was fixed by adding RequestIdFilter to all handlers, not just the root logger.

verified_features.socket_io_connection: Frontend connects to Socket.IO server at /api/socket.io/ and authenticates successfully
verified_features.broadcast_ticket_created: POST /api/tickets triggers real-time broadcast with properly serialized data (no _id)
verified_features.broadcast_ticket_update: PUT /api/tickets/{id} triggers broadcast_ticket_update with 4 arguments (ticket_id, action, data, updated_by)
verified_features.frontend_realtime_handler: TicketsListView receives ticket:created events and adds new tickets to list without refresh
verified_features.serialize_doc: All API responses and Socket.IO broadcasts have _id stripped and datetime fields as ISO strings
verified_features.email_sync_endpoint: POST /api/email/sync works correctly, returns proper counts (emails_found, tickets_created, replies_added)

bugs_fixed_in_this_iteration.logging_error: ValueError: Formatting field not found in record: 'request_id' - Socket.IO internal loggers didn't have RequestIdFilter
bugs_fixed_in_this_iteration.socket_routing: Socket.IO endpoint returned 404/HTML because mount path didn't match Kubernetes ingress routing

test_evidence.api_response: Ticket TKT-000104 created via API appeared in frontend list via real-time update
